summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload unrelated to the package's stated purpose
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub release archive into a temporary directory, extracts it, marks the binary executable, and invokes it against a 727 KB sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and has the characteristic obfuscator.io shape: a large numeric/string array (`n7gIxM`), a rotator function (`WV8StW`), hex-mangled `_0x`-style identifiers, and character-code string assembly. Neither the fetched runtime nor the obfuscated payload have any connection to the package's advertised monorepo-config purpose, and the payload is deliberately structured to defeat source review and Node-based static analysis by executing under an alternate runtime downloaded at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
